candidates.description: The tokens represent German verb stems and adjective roots commonly used in business or technical contexts to describe functions, features, and requirements.
These tokens represent German pronominal adverbs, demonstrative adverbs, and locative/temporal pro-forms functioning as spatial or logical connectors.
This vector represents abstract spatial, dimensional, and quantitative relationships.
This feature vector represents German lexical prefixes, particularly past participle and nominalization markers starting with 'ge-'.
This feature activates on words, suffixes, and name components ending with the "-ank" or "-unk" phonetic sound sequence.
These tokens represent German modal verbs and their conjugated forms, indicating necessity, ability, or permission.
This feature vector activates on German subordinating conjunctions and common grammatical prefixes.
This feature vector represents the German language, particularly common German letter combinations, morphs, and words.
This vector is related to technical computing terminology, software components, and programming concepts.
These tokens represent common German grammatical prepositions.
